description: The current user's trade circle: friends, requests_received (waiting for the user: accept_friend or remove_friend), requests_sent (waiting for the friend), each by handle with the date. places_taken counts friends and requests sent against cap (null = no limit). handle is the user's own, null when they have none. invites: the invite links the user made (invite_friend), each for one player, with its state: open, waiting (a newcomer signed up and has not accepted yet: they have no handle, so they are told here, not under requests_sent), accepted, closed or expired. An open or waiting link takes a place against cap; cancel_invite gives it back.
name: my_circle

cap.description: Friends the account's plan holds, requests sent included; null = no limit

since.description: When the request was sent, or the friendship began

handle.description: The user's own handle; null when they have none (they need one to add friends)

invites.description: Invite links the user made (invite_friend), newest first: the last 30 days, and any still waiting. Open and waiting ones take a place against cap

state.description: open: can bring someone in; waiting: a newcomer signed up and has not accepted; accepted; closed: used, request withdrawn or declined; expired

url.description: The invite link to send again while open

places_taken.description: Friends, requests sent and open invite links, counted together against cap

requests_received.description: Waiting for the user: accept_friend or remove_friend

since.description: When the request was sent, or the friendship began

requests_sent.description: Waiting for the friend to accept

since.description: When the request was sent, or the friendship began

title: My circle
